declaration.scope: Synthetic HTTP/1.1 POST admission via unmodified HAProxy; two front client batches with persistent requests; separate legacy-C and restricted-HC/C origin listeners; one macOS host. No latency or population-rate inference.
declaration.operator_requirement: Both initiating peers authenticate their servers. /restricted requires hybrid on front and selected backend before origin application acceptance; /compat adds no hybrid requirement. Trusted gateway may buffer eager client input.
declaration.boundary: Origin application acceptance of a complete bounded request, not successful client TLS write and not a real financial transaction.
declaration.reuse: http-reuse always; actual reuse measured from origin TLS connection IDs and correlated request IDs, not inferred from configuration
declaration.predictions: HTTP statuses frozen before collection. Exact connection counts and cross-client pooling are measured, not fitted; confirmations preserve unexpected results.
